summary: Added core.edit_task and core.remove_task, cli cmd_edit/cmd_remove and the edit and remove subcommands. edit_task validates everything (unknown id, nothing to edit, due with no_due, blank title, bad date, bad priority) before mutating, using `is not None` for option presence; error messages are CLI-ready and cmd_edit prints str(error).
assumptions: No-field message is 'error: nothing to edit'; due with no-due is 'error: --due and --no-due cannot be used together'.
Check order: unknown id, nothing to edit, due with no-due, title, due, priority.
